sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le yí gè juédìng.
Zhè shì yí gè hěn nán de juédìng.

sentences.english: I like playing tennis on weekends.

sentences.chinese: 他是一位有名的网球运动员。
sentences.pinyin: Tā shì yí wèi yǒumíng de wǎngqiú yùndòngyuán.
sentences.english: He is a famous tennis player.

sentences.chinese: 照片有点模糊，看不清楚。
sentences.pinyin: Zhàopiàn yǒudiǎn móhu, kàn bu qīngchu.
sentences.english: The photo is a bit blurry, can't see clearly.

sentences.chinese: 请让我澄清一下这个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng ràng wǒ chéngqīng yíxià zhège wèntí.
sentences.english: Please let me clarify this issue.

sentences.chinese: 公司发表声明澄清误会。
sentences.english: The company issued a statement to clarify the misunderstanding.

sentences.chinese: 他非常重视自己的名誉。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fēicháng zhòngshì zìjǐ de míngyù.
sentences.english: He values his own reputation very much.

sentences.chinese: 这件事会损害公司的名誉。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì huì sǔnhài gōngsī de míngyù.
sentences.english: This matter will damage the company's reputation.
